tasks.title: Create VideoHostingService — Supabase Storage upload utility for TikTok PULL_FROM_URL
tasks.context: The TikTok Content Posting API uses PULL_FROM_URL which requires a publicly accessible URL. The pipeline currently passes cv.file_path (local path like /Users/tarekmnif/kognai/workspace/scs001/run-XXX/caption/video-captioned.mp4) as mediaUrl — TikTok cannot fetch from localhost. Supabase Storage is already shared infrastructure (package.json has @supabase/supabase-js ^2.98.0). Videos are ~100KB (mock) to ~2MB (production), well within free tier. The scs001-videos bucket will be created automatically by ensureBucket() if missing.

tasks.title: Wire VideoHostingService into PublishingAgent for live mode video upload before TikTok post
tasks.context: agents/scs001-publishing/index.ts was updated in Sprint 098 to respect this.mode (no longer hardcoded dryRun:true). The file now has: constructor(mode: 'mock'|'live'='mock'), dryRun: this.mode !== 'live', and mediaUrl: cv.file_path with comment 'LIVE: mediaUrl must be a publicly accessible URL for TikTok PULL_FROM_URL. Local file paths will not work. Hosting layer integration required.' This task fulfills that TODO: when mode is live and Supabase is configured, upload first, use public_url as mediaUrl. The try/catch around upload ensures graceful degradation — if Supabase upload fails, pipeline continues (TikTok posting may fail but no crash). Depends on 099-01 (VideoHostingService module).

tasks.title: Create validate-production-preflight.ts — env var checklist for live TikTok posting
tasks.context: The operator needs a single command to check all prerequisites before attempting live TikTok posting. Currently there is no way to verify TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, SCS_EDITING_MODE, SCS_MODE, and ecosystem.config.js in one shot. Pattern follows existing validators (validate-phase0-gate.ts, validate-phase1-activation.ts, validate-production-quality.ts). Independent of 099-01/099-02 — uses only fs/path imports, no Supabase SDK. The fix_hint for each check gives exact operator instructions. Secrets are truncated at 8 chars to prevent token leakage in logs.
